name: RequestRelease
description: Submit a sales order for release approval (maker step). Does not release the order; a Manager must ApproveOrder afterwards. ALWAYS use this for 'request release', 'request release for order', 'submit for approval', 'yêu cầu duyệt', 'xin duyệt'. Never map those phrases to ReleaseOrder.
